other_conditions: Candidate must be a domicile of India.
Candidate must be a permanent resident of the state of Manipur.
Applicant must be a civil service student.
Candidate must be a meritorious and brilliant IAS aspirant of Manipur.
benefits_summary: Provides offline IAS coaching to the top 500 candidates, with full scholarships for the top 200 and partial grants (40‑75%) for ranks 201‑500.
documents_required: Any valid identification proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, passport, driver’s license, bank passbook, etc.)
Birth certificate or Class 10th mark sheet
